Money fields in the decoder are integer base units; no float money is produced.

Behaviour change for callers: RpcError and DataStale now report their own redacted message (for example 'rpc bad body method=... endpoints=N') instead of the generic 'authority check failed' / 'holder check failed'. Non-RPC, non-malformed exceptions now propagate to the caller instead of returning ok:false. ArithmeticError was added to the malformed tuple in a523273 after a 400-digit integer escaped float() in holders.py. authorities.py has no float conversion, so it has no matching overflow test; the tuple change there is for consistency.

Pump decoder layouts are not in the repo. TradeEvent (through mayhem_mode, including ix_name before mayhem_mode), CreateEvent (stops before token_program and is_mayhem_mode, which are trailing bytes and ignored), CompleteEvent, CompletePumpAmmMigrationEvent and PostCompleteBuyEvent follow the research spec and the public pump IDL as recalled; they are unverified against chain.
